responsibility: Computes and reports classic register statistics derived from RTL dataflow for use by later backend heuristics and dumps. It initializes REG_N_SETS and REG_N_REFS from df chains, walks basic blocks backward with live sets to derive REG_N_DEATHS, REG_N_CALLS_CROSSED, REG_BASIC_BLOCK locality, pseudo frequencies, and setjmp-crossing information, provides a lighter call-crossing-only computation for scheduler users, and emits human-readable register summaries for dumps.
